Name: Ghost Boy Vincent - Chinese
Author: Shizuo1412
Description:
————————————
【前提】

[list]
[*]模组的背景假设星露谷内无人存活，而玩家可能也在开局的那场车祸里丧命。（玩家也可能是类似于法师的存在）
[*]文森特是唯一一个意识到这一事实的存在，他看得见其他人看不见的幽灵生物。也有一个可爱的小幽灵陪在他身边，常常和他对话。
[/list]—— ——
【简介】

       文森特是一个阳光开朗的[b]可爱[/b]小男孩！
       他认识一位特殊的“朋友”，这位朋友会给他讲很多事情，偶尔会提及关于“山谷”的真相。
       他喜欢软糖，喜欢冒险题材的故事，
       喜欢听哥哥唱歌，喜欢和贾斯一起玩，喜欢和潘妮小姐一起读书，喜欢听你说话。
       他很喜欢你，所以经常会给你分享很实用的礼物。（部分资源和食物）
       他虽然意识到山谷不太一样，但他只是个小朋友，因此他不会多想那些逻辑问题。
       你会随着好感增加慢慢了解山谷内的“真相”，大部分多数时候和他的对话都是[u]轻松幽默[/u]的。

—— ——

[list]
[*]日常对话里包含三条选择类对话，所有选择都不会减少文森特的好感度，请放心大胆地享受对话(*╹▽╹*)
[*]展示图里的肖像来自[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22282]Fishking's All the villagers Portraits[/url]，真的很可爱！如果你也喜欢该肖像，请去该链接下载它！
[*]如果你下载了其他的对话模组拓展，可能会导致该模组里的部分对话被覆盖。解决方法是下载副文件，它能减少被覆盖的可能性。
[/list]﻿————————————

以下是机翻后的英文简介。
﻿The following is an English introduction after machine translation.

﻿————————————
【Prerequisite】

[list]
[*]The background assumption of the module is that no one survived in the Star Dew Valley, and the player may have died in the car accident at the beginning of the game. (Players may also be similar to mages)
[*]Vincent is the only one who is aware of this fact, he can see ghostly creatures that others cannot see. There is also a cute little ghost by his side, often conversing with him.
[/list]—— ——
【Introduction】

         Vincent is a sunny and lovely little boy!
         He knows a special "friend" who will tell him many things and occasionally mention the truth about the "valley".
         He likes gummies and adventurous stories,
         I enjoy listening to my brother sing, playing with Jas, reading with Miss Penny, and listening to you talk.
         He likes you very much, so he often shares practical gifts with you. (Some resources and food)
         Although he realized that the valley was different, he was just a child, so he wouldn't think too much about those logical questions.
         You will gradually understand the "truth" in the valley as your liking increases, and most of the time, conversations with him are light hearted and humorous.
—— ——

[list]
[*]There are three options in daily conversations, all of which will not reduce Vincent's favorability. Please feel free to enjoy the conversation boldly (* ╹▽╹ *)
[*]The portrait in the display picture is from [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22282]Fishking's All the villagers Portraits[/url] , it's really cute! If you also like this portrait, please go to the link to download it!
[/list]
—— ——

祝你玩的愉快！
